exitSearchConclusion: No later Black Hills Colorado IPP sale, Argo/AIA exit, signed pending transfer or ownership restructuring was identified through August 16, 2026. Black Hills' August 2026 Form 10-Q continued to report the IPP noncontrolling interest. The Apollo-Argo manager transaction was terminated without closing, and the pending Black Hills-NorthWestern corporate merger does not itself transfer Argo's 49.9% IPP interest.
